steps.note: Plus any task the user flagged 'notify me when done'.

steps.condition: a watched condition is now met (e.g. task completed, or a reply arrived)
steps.note: Reply-arrival check is Flow A with a sender/subject filter; do not poll Gmail more than every 6h on the free tier.

success_criteria: Notification fires once when the condition flips, and never for tasks that are still pending.
test: Mark a test task awaiting_approval, complete it, run the flow manually, confirm exactly one notification.

trigger.note: Also callable by webhook with {task_id} for an on-demand check.
